title: Swing Arm Towel Rail 12.5-Inch Solid Brass Double Arm | Assorted Wall Accessories | Allied Brass
description:
Get flexible towel storage that fits tight layouts. This wall-mounted swing arm towel rail (also called a towel bar, towel rack, or towel holder) gives you two arms that pivot independently, then fold in close to the wall when not in use for a space-saving bathroom setup.

Highlights:
- Save space near sinks and showers: double swing arms swivel independently and tuck close to the wall
- Keep towels organized and reachable: two pivoting arms provide flexible placement for everyday routines
- Cleaner finished look on the wall: concealed screw mounting hardware
- Built to last: solid brass construction

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 12.5 x 7.1 x 7 inches
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 12 x 12 inches
- Shipping weight: 7 lbs
- Mounting: wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging with concealed screw mounting hardware
- Collection: Assorted Wall Accessories collection
- Style context: transitional bathroom hardware; versatile bath accessories
- Finish options: multiple designer finish options available
